page.overview:
What is Mismagius?

Mismagius is a large purple ghost Pokémon with a head shaped like a magician's hat. The "necklace" on its neck of its previous stage has turned into the three red gems on its body.

A shiny Mismagius's entire body is yellow-green while its gems are pink.

Unlike its pre-evolution, Misdreavus, it's no longer mischievous but becomes mature and steady, so it turns into an ally of its trainer instead of a little partner. Because of its powerful moves, it's easier to rely on.

Sometimes, Mismagius can be considered as elusive, since nobody can portend when it will torture or give blessings to people on a whim, so wild ones are always dreaded.
